helpPage.title: Taimako Taimako
helpPage.centerDesc: Yi amfani da wannan cibiyar tallafi don tsalle zuwa fasalin Humaeli na dama, magance matsalolin gama gari, da fahimtar lokacin da za a tuntuɓar taimakon gaggawa a wajen ƙa'idar.
helpPage.aiWellnessDesc: Yi tambayoyin lafiya-tunani, yi amfani da shigar da murya, samun amsa cikin sauri, kuma ci gaba da taɗi na AI kwanan nan daga dashboard.
helpPage.counselorDesc: Bincika masu ba da shawara da suna, ƙwarewa, harshe, wuri, ƙima, da matsayin kan layi kafin fara kulawa.
helpPage.appointmentsDesc: Yi bitar alƙawura masu zuwa da waɗanda suka gabata, duba matsayin buƙatun, da zaman littafi tare da masu ba da shawara.
helpPage.walletDesc: Ƙara kuɗi, duba ma'amaloli, zazzage rahotannin walat, da tuntuɓar tallafin don tambayoyin biyan kuɗi.
helpPage.checklist1: Tabbatar da haɗin Intanet ɗin ku kuma sabunta ƙa'idar kafin yin rahoton matsalar lodawa.
helpPage.checklist2: Ajiye sabon hoton allo, ainihin lokacin, da sunan allo a shirye lokacin da ake tuntuɓar tallafi.
helpPage.checklist3: Don kamara, makirufo, sanarwa, da batutuwan wuri, fara bincika izinin aikace-aikacen na'urar.
helpPage.checklist4: Don batutuwan biyan kuɗi, sun haɗa da kwanan wata, adadin, matsayin ciniki, da ma'aunin walat da aka nuna a cikin app.
helpPage.aiChatNotReplyDesc: Bincika haɗin Intanet ɗin ku, gwada aika ɗan gajeren saƙo, kuma sake buɗe taɗi na AI daga dashboard. Idan har yanzu ta gaza, raba ainihin hoton hoton kuskure tare da goyan baya.

helpPage.callNotConnectingDesc: Tabbatar cewa mai ba da shawara ya karɓi taɗi/zamanku, duka masu amfani suna kan layi, kuma an ba da izinin makirufo/kamara.
helpPage.walletPaymentIssueDesc: Bude Wallet don duba sabuwar ciniki da zazzage rahoto. Raba kwanan wata, adadin, da matsayin ma'amala lokacin tuntuɓar tallafi.
helpPage.languageWrongDesc: Yi amfani da zaɓin harshe daga dashboard/saituna. Wasu masu ba da shawara ko bayanan likita na iya kasancewa a cikin yaren da mai bada ya shigar.

privacyPage.title: Manufar Keɓantawa
privacyPage.centerDesc: Wannan cibiyar keɓancewa tana bayanin yadda Humaeli ke amfani da bayanan ku, taɗi, alƙawari, walat, kira, wurin aiki, da bayanan tsaro a cikin wannan wayar hannu.
privacyPage.anonCareDesc: Nuna wa masu ba da shawara inda aka tallafa
privacyPage.dataUsedTitle: Bayanan da aka yi amfani da su a cikin app
privacyPage.profileHealthDesc: Sunanka, sunan nuni da ba a san suna ba, shekaru, jinsi, bayanan tuntuɓar, hoto/avatar, adireshi, lambar gaggawa, cikakkun bayanan likita, da filayen inshora ana amfani da su don kula da bayanan majiyyatan ku.
privacyPage.aiConversations: AI taɗi da tattaunawa mai ba da shawara

privacyPage.appointmentsDesc: Kwanan alkawari, lokaci, dalili/bayanin kula, matsayi, mai ba da shawara da aka sanya, kira metadata, da tarihin zama na taimaka wa masu amfani da masu ba da shawara su sarrafa kulawa.
privacyPage.walletDesc: Ana amfani da ma'auni na walat, haɓakawa, bayanan ma'amala, rahotannin da aka samar, da mahallin tallafi masu alaƙa don biyan biyan kuɗi.

privacyPage.securityDesc: Alamu na shiga, mai ba da izini, matsayin kalmar sirri, tabbaci na OTP, matsayi, da matsayin asusu ana amfani da su don ware wuraren masu amfani da masu ba da shawara.
privacyPage.visibleDesc: Dashboard ɗinku yana nuna bayanin martabarku, hirar AI, hulɗar mai ba da shawara, alƙawura, walat, tarihin kira, faɗakarwar ƙima, da sarrafa wuri/sabuntawa.

privacyPage.protectedAccess: An kiyaye shi ta hanyar sarrafa shiga
privacyPage.protectedDesc: An raba yankunan mai amfani da masu ba da shawara ta hanyar rawar aiki, zaman aiki, tabbatarwar OTP, da ingantattun buƙatun API.
